title: Origins of Kalari
description: Demonstrate your understanding of the martial art's origin.
question_text: Kalaripayattu is a famous ancient martial art. Which beautiful green state in India does it come from?
explanation: Kalaripayattu was born in Kerala, a state in southern India known for its beautiful palm trees and backwaters.

title: Stance Knowledge
question_text: In Kalaripayattu, fighters learn to move like animals! Which of these is a popular animal movement they learn?
options: ["The sleeping bear", "The roaring lion (Simhavadivu)", "The hopping kangaroo", "The swimming fish"]
explanation: Kalaripayattu uses many animal stances like the lion, elephant, and snake to teach balance and strength.

title: Healing Arts
description: Knowledge of the dual nature of Kalari.
question_text: A Kalari master (Gurukkal) doesn't just teach fighting. What else do they learn to help people?
options: ["How to heal people with traditional medicine", "How to build castles", "How to bake cakes", "How to sew clothes"]
correct_answer: How to heal people with traditional medicine
explanation: A true Gurukkal is also a healer who uses traditional medicine to help people feel better.

title: The Flexible Blade
question_text: There is a very special sword used in Kalaripayattu that is bendy and can be worn like a belt. What is it called?
options: ["A heavy club", "A giant axe", "The Urumi (Flexible Sword)", "A short dagger"]
explanation: The Urumi is a unique, flexible sword. It takes many years of careful practice to learn how to use it safely!

title: Identifying the Rajput Armor
question_text: Which of these armor types was famously worn by Rajput warriors for its combination of protection and mobility?
explanation: Zirah Bakhtar, or chainmail with interlinked rings, provided crucial mobility in the desert heat.

title: Path of the Warrior
description: Make a choice based on Rajput ethos.
question_text: A warrior falls in battle. What is the highest honor they achieve according to Rajput tradition?
options: ["Wealth for their family", "Veergati (Martyrdom)", "A grand tomb", "Political power"]
explanation: Veergati, attaining heaven through a glorious death in battle, was the ultimate honor.

title: Defense Strategy
question_text: The fort is besieged. What is the traditional final defense strategy of Mewar?
options: ["Surrender", "Flee through secret tunnels", "Saka and Jauhar", "Negotiate tribute"]
explanation: When defeat was certain, warriors would perform Saka (fight to the death) and women Jauhar to protect their honor.

title: Find the Tiger's Claws
question_text: Search the armory and discover the hidden Bagh Nakh.
explanation: The Bagh Nakh (Tiger's Claw) was famously used by Shivaji Maharaj.

title: Discover the Fort
question_text: You have discovered the capital fort of the Maratha Empire. What is its name?
explanation: Raigad Fort served as the capital of the Maratha Empire under Shivaji Maharaj.

title: Match the Regions
description: Match the martial arts to their regions.
question_text: Match the following: Kalaripayattu, Mardani Khel, Gatka.
explanation: Kalaripayattu is from Kerala, Mardani Khel from Maharashtra, and Gatka from Punjab.

title: The Imperial Port
description: Identify the ancient port city of the Cholas.
question_text: Which ancient city served as a major port and capital of the early Chola kingdom?
explanation: Kaveripoompattinam, also known as Puhar, was a bustling ancient port city mentioned extensively in Sangam literature.

title: Sacred Dance
description: Identify the origin of a classical dance.
question_text: Which classical dance form originated in the Hindu temples of Tamil Nadu?
explanation: Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance traditions of India, deeply rooted in the temple culture of Tamil Nadu.

title: Ruins of an Empire
question_text: You stand before the magnificent ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire's capital. What is its modern name?
explanation: Hampi is a UNESCO World Heritage site representing the magnificent ruins of the Vijayanagara capital.

title: The Patron Emperor
description: Know the famous ruler of Vijayanagara.
question_text: The Emperor's legacy lives on in his literature and military conquests. Who is the most celebrated ruler of this empire?
explanation: Krishnadevaraya presided over the empire at its zenith and is regarded as an icon of culture, literature, and military might.

title: Kerala's Heritage
question_text: What traditional martial art is featured in the Kerala chapter?
explanation: Kalaripayattu is the traditional martial art featured in the Kerala chapter.

title: The Kalari
question_text: Where do students practice Kalaripayattu?
options: ["In a sunken dirt pit called a Kalari", "On top of a snowy mountain", "Inside a swimming pool", "On a moving boat"]
correct_answer: In a sunken dirt pit called a Kalari
explanation: A traditional Kalari is a special rectangular pit dug into the ground to keep the practice area cool and sacred.

title: Role of the Gurukkal
question_text: What is the respectful name for a teacher or master of Kalaripayattu?
explanation: The teacher is called a Gurukkal, and students treat them with great respect for their wisdom and skill.

title: Weapon Knowledge: Vaal
question_text: Before learning to use swords or shields, what do Kalari students practice first?
options: ["Riding horses", "Flying airplanes", "Body exercises and animal stances", "Singing songs"]
explanation: Students must build a strong and flexible body using special exercises and stances before using any tools.

title: Weapon Knowledge: Paricha
question_text: When using a sword in Kalari, warriors also use a small shield to protect themselves. What is this shield called?
explanation: The Paricha is a small, round shield used to quickly block and push away attacks during combat.

title: Historical Decline
question_text: Kalaripayattu is a very old art, but people still learn it today. Why is it good to learn Kalaripayattu?
options: ["It helps you fly", "It makes you invisible", "It keeps your body healthy and your mind focused", "It gives you magical powers"]
correct_answer: It keeps your body healthy and your mind focused
explanation: Learning Kalari is a great way to stay active, flexible, and learn how to concentrate better.

title: Rajputana Heritage
question_text: What does the term 'Rajput' traditionally mean?
options: ["Son of the Desert", "Son of a King", "Master of the Sword", "Defender of the Faith"]
explanation: Rajput originates from the Sanskrit word Rajputra, meaning son of a king.

title: The Mighty Forts
question_text: Which architectural structures are most famously associated with the defense of Rajasthan?
options: ["Underground catacombs", "Massive hill forts like Kumbhalgarh", "Floating palaces", "Deep stepwells"]
explanation: Rajasthan is renowned for its massive hill forts that served as self-sustaining cities during sieges.

title: Weapon Knowledge: Talwar
question_text: What is the primary characteristic of a traditional Talwar?
options: ["It is a heavy, double-edged straight sword", "It is a curved sword designed for powerful slashing cuts", "It is a flexible whip-sword", "It is a short throwing dagger"]
correct_answer: It is a curved sword designed for powerful slashing cuts
explanation: The Talwar is characterized by its curved blade, making it highly effective for slashing cuts in battle.

title: Weapon Knowledge: Dhal
question_text: The Rajput Dhal (shield) was traditionally made of steel or which animal hide?
explanation: Many high-quality Dhals were made from the thick, durable hide of the rhinoceros.

title: Code of Honor
question_text: What was the ultimate expression of the strict Rajput code of honor during an inevitable defeat?
options: ["Saka and Jauhar", "Strategic retreat into the desert", "Paying heavy tribute", "Forming alliances with the enemy"]
explanation: Saka (fighting to the death) and Jauhar were practiced to protect honor when defeat was certain.
